risks.vram: 8 GB is tight for ComfyUI + Ollama coexistence; VRAM manager offloads Ollama before ComfyUI loads.
risks.storage: SATA SSD limits parallel write throughput; keep concurrent encodes to 2.
risks.cpu: Ryzen 5 5500 has no AVX-512; some PyTorch ops fall back to AVX2.

_ollama_0.40_notes.api_endpoint: /api/chat is the recommended endpoint for multimodal vision (replaces /api/generate for images)
_ollama_0.40_notes.think_parameter: Extended reasoning supported on gemma4, qwen3.5, muse-glimmer (values: true/false/max/high/medium/low); /api/show reports the exact values and default per model (0.34.3+)
_ollama_0.40_notes.keep_alive: Model metadata is now cached server-side; keep_alive 10m still recommended for resident model stickiness
_ollama_0.40_notes.structured_output: format=json_schema enforces JSON shape on chat completions (0.33+); on thinking models it applies in a single pass (0.34.4+)
_ollama_0.40_notes.ttft_improvement: 0.33+ caches resolved model metadata, cutting TTFT roughly in half vs earlier versions
_ollama_0.40_notes.capabilities: /api/tags and /api/show report per-model capabilities (completion/vision/audio/tools/thinking/embedding) and the runner (ggml on this Windows build; mlx is the 0.40.0 default on Apple Silicon only)
_ollama_0.40_notes.deprecated: typical_p can no longer be set when creating models (0.34.1+); sending it logs a warning instead of failing (0.35.0+)
_ollama_0.40_notes.win_0.40_6: Prevents orphaned runners on Windows after Ollama server crash or restart
_ollama_0.40_notes.gguf_0.40_6: q2_0 tensor and file types now supported for ultra-low-bitrate GGUF models
_ollama_0.40_notes.api_0.40_7: /api/show exposes renderer, parser, and template_source fields per model; Responses API thinking/no-thinking switches no longer fail mid-conversation
_ollama_0.40_notes.notes_0.40_8: Flint coding model (Recursive MoE, 262K context) - macOS only at 0.40.8; llama.cpp bump b11845
_ollama_0.40_notes.notes_0.40_9: Flint now supported on Linux and Windows; d3 decision models (classify/yes-no/score); Speech/Phonon TTS (Apple Silicon); OpenAI Responses/Anthropic streaming report failures instead of silent partial output
_ollama_0.40_notes.notes_0.40_10: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B - Gemma 4-based vision-language model, 128K context, DFlash speculative decoding
